title: SHELLR's "Pigs & Bullies (Radio Edit)": A Powerful Message on Life's Hardships
htmlContent:
SHELLR's recent release, "Pigs & Bullies (Radio Edit)," is a hard-hitting track that profoundly delves into life's hardships and survival struggles. The derby rapper's raw energy and high-frequency music, influenced by his life experiences, create a powerful message that resonates with his listeners.

Produced by RXKZ, the song features catchy lyrics and punchlines that make it easy to understand and appreciate. Using wordplay and metaphors is a testament to SHELLR's complex lyric writing and storytelling abilities.

Despite his young age, SHELLR has been rapping for over a decade, and his talent is undeniable. Influenced by legends like Immortal technique and Ghetts, SHELLR has crafted a unique, authentic, refreshing sound.

In "Pigs & Bullies (Radio Edit)," SHELLR's message is clear: life can be challenging, but we must persevere. His music is a reflection of his struggles and emotions, and he uses it as a way to express himself and inspire others.

With his recent signing to DICE RECORDINGS, SHELLR is poised to make an even more significant impact on the UK music scene. "Pigs & Bullies (Radio Edit)" is just the beginning of what promises to be an exciting career for this rising star
